mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 73 degrees. The moon is in its Third Quarter phase, and if you are up early, the ISS will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 4:19 AM as it travels from the northwest near Verona High School toward Fitchburg in the east, reaching about halfway up the sky. Tonight, we will drop to an overnight low of 71 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

In city news, Verona has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park near Art House 360. This seven-foot-tall wooden piece, carved from a fallen ash tree by Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, celebrates traditional Tai Chi movements and was donated by Gerri Gurman.

There is plenty to do this week. Tomorrow, you can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Looking further ahead, Live Music returns to Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 4, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market kicks off at Hometown Junction Park on September 9.

In a noteworthy call from this past week, on Friday, August 30, officers were dispatched to North Edge Trail regarding a vehicle window being smashed; an arrest warrant has since been issued for a suspect identified in the case.
Culver's is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing what the flavor of the day is when they reopen tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM.
